If you require any content on this website in an alternate format, please contact us at mathstat@mcmaster.ca and we will respond as promptly as possible. If you have an accommodation need for a planned meeting, event, or interview, including alternative formats or communication supports, please e-mail or call us to make the appropriate arrangements.
If there is an AODA web accessibility issue with this website, please report it to Media Production Services using our AODA bug reporting form.
